chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrahim, from Mismāʿ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning

A man who killed the fetus of a slave-woman belonging to some people while it was in her womb—he said: "If it died in her womb after he struck her, then half of one-tenth of the value of the slave-woman is due from him; and if he struck her and she cast it out alive, then one-tenth of the value of its mother is due from him."

key_terms.أَمَةٍ: slave-woman; a female bondswoman whose value is legally assessed
key_terms.جَنِينِ: fetus; the unborn child in the womb
key_terms.حَيًّا: alive; indicating live expulsion from the womb
key_terms.ضَرَبَهَا: he struck her; the act causing the injury
key_terms.عُشْرَ قِيمَةِ أُمِّهِ: one-tenth of the value of its mother; the compensation due in that case
key_terms.قِيمَةِ الْأَمَةِ: the value of the slave-woman; the monetary basis for calculating compensation
key_terms.نِصْفُ عُشْرِ: half of one-tenth; the specified portion of compensation

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due for killing the fetus of a slave-woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for causing the death of the fetus of a slave-woman. It distinguishes between the fetus dying in the womb after the assault and being expelled alive, assigning a different financial compensation in each case based on the value of the mother.
